title: skins.stattrak (server → platform, reliable, critical)
description: Proposed by Ready Up (D6, D13, FLEET.md §8.3). StatTrak kills since the last one, batched (at most one every 10 s). defindex is the painted weapon's defindex (skins.loadout paints[].defindex). The platform adds `kills` to its counter and sends the new count in the next skins.loadout.
